covered: ADR-0005 vs drafts.md and lint.mjs (ran lint on drafts and on a bad sample)
deny message (ADR-0008) vs PR rules and v1 archaeology

findings.claim: drafts mode never fails: it prints fail[] and exits 0, so 'lint = 0 failures' (GP2) is not enforced.
findings.evidence: Sample with 'You MUST use ctx_foo <rule>': output fail:["instructions"], exit=0. No process.exitCode anywhere in lint.mjs.
findings.fix: Set process.exitCode=1 when fail.length>0; same in files mode.

findings.claim: ADR says CI lints the built tools/list and initialize output; lint.mjs has only 'drafts' and 'files' modes, and files mode skips PR6/PR11/PR12 and budgets.
findings.evidence: lint.mjs:13-26: modes drafts|files; files mode prints caps/doubt/tags/quoted only, no fail set, no prefixed/unknownRefs/char budget.
findings.fix: Add a 'live' mode that reads JSON of initialize+tools/list (incl. input schemas for the 8,000 budget) and applies every PR rule; note it as GP2 input.

findings.claim: TECH-SPEC still says 7 tool files and 7 descriptions = 2,353 chars; drafts has 9 tools and lint measures 3,139 chars. README:101 and PRD:113 also say 7, PRD:289 and ADR-0007:51 say 9.
findings.evidence: TECH-SPEC.md:107 '(x7)', :124-125 'other 6 descriptions', 'all 7 descriptions | 2,353'; node lint.mjs drafts -> toolDescChars 3139, ids incl. ctx_doctor, ctx_upgrade, ctx_purge.
findings.fix: Regenerate 3.5 from the script with 9 tools; fix 3.3, README 8, PRD 7 to 9.

findings.claim: TECH-SPEC says rules are PR1-PR11; ADR-0005 has PR12, listed before PR11.
findings.evidence: TECH-SPEC.md:116 'PR1–PR11 are listed in ADR-0005'; ADR-0005:54-55 PR12 then PR11.

findings.claim: PR6 comment sits on the PR12 line; the quoted regex counts only double quotes, so a trigger list in backticks or single quotes passes PR6.
findings.evidence: lint.mjs:7 quoted:/"[^"\n]{2,60}"/g has no PR6 tag; :8 ends with '// PR12 ... // PR6'.
findings.fix: Move the comment; count backtick and single-quoted phrases too, or define PR6 as double quotes only in ADR-0005.

findings.claim: v2 deny message drops the 'full network access' statement and the transient-DNS retry hint that v1 added so models stop reading the deny as a network block. The text is also not in drafts.md, so no lint covers it.
findings.evidence: v1 hooks/core/routing.mjs:879 '...Both have full network access. Retry the same call on a transient DNS error (EAI_AGAIN, ETIMEDOUT, ENETUNREACH).' ADR-0008:38-43 template has neither. drafts.md has no deny id.
findings.fix: Add <!-- id: deny_bash --> and <!-- id: deny_webfetch --> to drafts.md, keep a one-line 'it has network access; retry on a transient DNS error' clause, lint them with PR1/PR5/PR12, golden in GP3.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY 9e29a940 2026-05-24 'fix(server): comprehensive ctx_* tool description audit + WebFetch refusal (substitutes #654) (#683)'; PR #654 'reword WebFetch deny so agents don't read it as network block' (CLOSED, prall.json). ORIGINAL_INTENT: 'reframed from the negation-heavy "blocked" voice ... append "retry if it fails with a transient DNS error" so the next action is explicit across all model tiers'. Kept by 4bc292fc (2026-05-31) tests: 'affirms full network access, ends with the canonical transient-DNS retry hint; no blocked'. REGRESSION_RISK: model gives up or answers from training on EAI_AGAIN. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: no 'blocked' word, positive imperative, retry hint kept.

findings.claim: Deny message prints the prefixed tool name ('Tool: <exact tool name for this agent>'), but TECH-SPEC 3.8 rule 1 says tool results name tools bare and PR12 lint fails on mcp__...ctx_.
findings.evidence: ADR-0008:41,45; TECH-SPEC 3.8 rule 1 'Prompt text (instructions, descriptions, the ctx-stats prompt, tool results) names tools bare'. v1 #1028/#1060 went the other way (platform name in resume snapshot).
findings.fix: State the exception in ADR-0005 (deny reason uses the adapter-table name, exempt from PR12, golden per agent) or drop the prefixed line. Pick one and write it in both docs.
findings.archaeology: v1 2b5cfef7 2026-03-21 'feat: platform-aware tool naming (#158 #163 #164)' and PR #1060 'pass platform tool name into PreCompact resume snapshot (#1028)' show v1 chose prefixed names in hook text; round4 live run shows the model called ToolSearch 'select:mcp__ctx__ctx_execute' after the deny. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: keep one-step ToolSearch loading on Claude Code.

findings.claim: The JSON line puts the literal 'state what you need' into intent when description is empty; a model that copies it verbatim sends a useless intent.
findings.evidence: ADR-0008:42 '"intent":<the description field, or "state what you need">'.
findings.fix: Omit intent when no description and add a prose line asking for it, or define the exact bytes in drafts.md.

findings.claim: ADR-0009 pointer lines tell the model to call ctx_resume(seq:N), but the ctx_resume description and PRD signature have no seq parameter.
findings.evidence: ADR-0009:75-76 '#<seq> (<bytes> B) ctx_resume(seq:<seq>)'; drafts.md:44 no seq; PRD-v2.md:128 'ctx_resume {session?}'.
findings.fix: Add seq to PRD 7 and to the description ('Pass seq to get one stored item in full'); add a GP6 golden.

findings.claim: ctx_route (the tool the Claude Code mcp_tool hook calls) is in no tool list and no doc says whether tools/list shows it. If shown, it needs a draft, lint and budget, and the model may call it; if hidden, it is unverified that an mcp_tool hook can call an unlisted tool.
findings.evidence: tickets/round4-evidence.json: 'the hook called ctx_route on the stub server'; ADR-0007:51 'tools/list returns the 9 tools'; grep ctx_route in docs/v2/*.md and adr: no hits.
findings.fix: Decide in ADR-0008/0007: listed or hidden; add an LV check for a hidden tool on mcp_tool hooks; if listed, add a drafts entry saying it is for hooks only.

findings.claim: The more: line and the wrapper's printed header are model-facing text with no draft and no lint; its format differs from ADR-0009's 'more: ctx_search(...)'; <terms> quoting into a shell line is not specified.
findings.fix: Add drafts ids more_bash and more_ctx with exact bytes; define terms escaping (single-quote, no shell expansion); GP3 golden runs the printed line.

findings.claim: Resume block uses pseudo-XML <context_mode_state>, which PR5 forbids if PR rules cover hook output; ADR-0005 does not say whether they do.
findings.evidence: ADR-0009:82,85; ADR-0005:48 PR5 '<[a-z_]+[ >]' = 0; v1 #911/#967 open: injected tag blocks tripped Claude Code auto-mode.
findings.fix: State the scope of PR rules (tool results and hook text in or out) and justify the tag as a data frame, or drop it.

findings.claim: Drafts say ctx_search default scope is still open (Q6); TECH-SPEC marks Q6 decided.
findings.evidence: drafts.md:5 'still an open question (Q6)'; TECH-SPEC.md:411 'Q6 ctx_search default scope = worktree [D]'.
